rows.name: variant?
rows.notes: How the indicator presents: `"symbol"` is the bare large symbol (the default), `"circle"` is a title-sized glyph in a tinted disc. The third configuration — title and subtitle alone — is obtained by not rendering the indicator part, not by a prop value.

rows.name: announce?
rows.notes: Puts `role="status"` on the root so a screen reader announces the placeholder when it appears — an emptied search result, a cleared list. Off by default: a static page-level empty state is not a live region.

rows.name: icon?
rows.notes: The symbol above the title — an inline SVG, never a text character. Left out, the indicator part is not placed at all, which is the third configuration (title and description alone) and not a `variant` value.

rows.name: title
rows.notes: What the placeholder says, and required for that reason — see above. Always placed, so the heading is what a reader and a screen reader both get.

rows.name: description?
rows.notes: The sentence under it: why the container is empty, or what would fill it.

rows.name: actions?
rows.notes: The row of ways out — the consumer's own buttons or links, in document order. Not a list of labels: there is no action-trigger part here for the library to place them on.
